description: Drives exactly one repair to exercise writerReuse live. The prompt names only the dash bug; the acceptance check, whose argv the writer never sees, also requires spelling out '&' as 'and'. run_checks is refused (reserveMs equals the time limit), so the first attempt fails verification and the failing assertion reaches the repair prompt.
prompt: slugify('Hello World') in src/slug.cjs returns 'hello world' instead of 'hello-world'. Fix slugify so words are joined with a dash.

rubric: slugify joins words with a dash
The acceptance check passes without weakening tests

checks.name: acceptance
argv: const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const {slugify}=require('./src/slug.cjs');assert.equal(slugify('Hello World'),'hello-world');assert.equal(slugify('Tom & Jerry'),'tom-and-jerry','house style: an ampersand is spelled out as and, so slugify("Tom & Jerry") must be "tom-and-jerry"');assert.equal(slugify('R&D Update'),'r-and-d-update','house style: an ampersand is spelled out as and, so slugify("R&D Update") must be "r-and-d-update"');
